curatedMovie.curiosityHook: How will Hache confront love, loss, and who he is becoming as he falls for Gin while still feeling for Babi?
curatedMovie.description: Returning to Barcelona after two years away, Hache hopes to start fresh. Instead, he finds himself drawn to Gin while still wrestling with unresolved feelings for his former flame, Babi.
curatedMovie.vibeSummary: An emotional, character-focused romantic drama with steady pacing, suited for reflective solo nights or shared date-night viewing.
curatedMovie.whyWatch: Directed by Fernando González Molina, this Spanish drama delivers a heartfelt, emotionally grounded romance about the messy friction between moving forward and letting go.
